EntryTitle: MODIS/Terra Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day L3 Global 1km SIN Grid V061
Abstract: The Terra Moderate Resolution Imaging Spectroradiometer (MODIS) Land Surface Temperature/Emissivity 8-Day (MOD11A2) Version 6.1 product provides an average 8-day per-pixel Land Surface Temperature and Emissivity (LST&E) with a 1 kilometer (km) spatial resolution in a 1,200 by 1,200 km grid.

MetadataAssociations.Description: MOD11A2 is derived from MOD11A1. Processing: 8-day temporal averaging of daily LST pixels. ATBD Section: 2.4. Source: 'Each pixel value in the MOD11A2 is a simple average of all the corresponding MOD11A1 LST pixels collected within that 8-day period.'

AssociationDetails.ProcessingMethodDescription: 8-day temporal averaging: MOD11A2[pixel] = mean(MOD11A1[pixel, day1:day8]) with minimum 4 valid days requirement. Aggregates daily LST observations into composite product.

RelatedUrl.Description: MOD11A1 collection landing page and documentation

AtbdReference.Quote: Each pixel value in the MOD11A2 is a simple average of all the corresponding MOD11A1 LST pixels collected within that 8-day period. The 8-day compositing period was chosen because twice that period is the exact ground track repeat period of the Terra and Aqua platforms.

ExtractionMetadata.ValidationNotes: Parent collection MOD11A1 verified in CMR. Processing level progression valid (L2→L3). Version compatibility confirmed (V6.1→V6.1).

MetadataAssociations.Description: MOD03 provides geolocation information required for spatial mapping and georeferencing of MOD11A2 pixels. Essential supporting data for pixel coordinate reference.

AssociationDetails.ProcessingMethodDescription: Geolocation reference: latitude/longitude per pixel at 1 km resolution. Used for spatial mapping and geographic registration.

AtbdReference.Quote: MOD03 geolocation data is required for pixel mapping and geographic registration of output products.

ExtractionMetadata.ValidationNotes: MOD03 verified as supporting input. Secondary rather than primary input collection.

MetadataAssociations.Description: MYD11A2 is the equivalent product from the Aqua platform. Both collections provide global LST observations with identical processing algorithms and output structure, enabling inter-platform comparison and complementary spatial/temporal coverage.

AssociationDetails.ProcessingMethodDescription: Identical processing to MOD11A2 but from Aqua MODIS instrument. Enables enhanced temporal coverage through combined Terra-Aqua observations.

ExtractionMetadata.ValidationNotes: Related through identical product architecture and processing chain.

MetadataProvenance.Source: ATBD-based lineage extraction with CMR validation
MetadataProvenance.ExtractionMethod: Automated ATBD parsing and UMM-C generation
